next.reason: 1985 SR3 bars a file-name USE that would request more than one USE procedure; since §1985:VIII.4.8.4 GR4 ('When file-name-1 is specified explicitly, no other USE statement applies to file-name-1') already lets a file-name USE coexist with INPUT/OUTPUT/I-O/EXTEND USEs, SR3 in effect bars the same file-name in two USE statements (mode a). 2023 §2023:14.9.49.3 SR8: 'The same file-name shall not appear in more than one USE AFTER EXCEPTION statement'; §2023:14.9.49.4 GR5 gives the file-name USE precedence over open-mode USEs and §2023:14.9.49.4 GR3 runs only 'the first declarative that satisfies the selection criteria'. Same requirement.
